function.arguments: {"sql":"SELECT AVG(list_price_cad) AS avg_list, AVG(wholesale_price_cad) AS avg_wholesale, AVG(list_price_cad - wholesale_price_cad) AS avg_diff\nFROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.product","purpose":"Average list and wholesale price difference"}
